people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
translations.bsb: As my hand seized the idolatrous kingdoms whose images surpassed those of Jerusalem and Samaria,
translations.kjv: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
